title: Completed adic realization of the Fourier character sheaves
statement: Fix a Fourier setting [def-fourier-set]: distinct primes $p,\ell$, $q=p^a$ with $a\geq1$, $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, its algebraic closure $k$, and a finite extension $E\subset\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ containing $\mu_p$. Let $\Psi:(\mathbf F_p,+)\to\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell^\times$ be any additive character, including the trivial one. Its values have a unique lift to $\mathcal O_E^\times$ through the fixed embedding; use that lift, with the canonical inverse of $p$ in $\mathcal O_E$, in the existing prime-field idempotent-image Artin--Schreier construction [def-fd-artin-schreier-sheaf]. For a scheme $X$ of characteristic $p$ and $b\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$, pull that integral étale sheaf to the small pro-étale site, identify constant-ring module sheaves with modules over the constant coefficient sheaf, and extend scalars through the canonical constant-to-completion map to $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,X}$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. This ordinary scalar extension, placed in degree zero, defines $\mathcal L^{\mathrm{adic}}_{\Psi,b}$. If $X$ is Noetherian it is in $D^b_c(X,\mathcal O_E)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed]: the finite étale torsor makes it the completed free rank-one sheaf, so its reductions are the rank-one character summands in degree zero, with uniform amplitude $[0,0]$. For $V\xrightarrow{\pi}S\xleftarrow{\pi'}V'$ with $V\times_SV'$ Noetherian of characteristic $p$ and pairing function $b$, apply this realization to the already defined Fourier kernel [def-fd-kernel], then rationalize and include it at the fixed finite stage $E$ in the common-stage category [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]; call the resulting object $\mathcal K^{\mathrm{adic}}_{\Psi,b}$. For $K\in D^b_c(V,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)$ and $\ell$ invertible on both source and product, its Fourier integrand is the existing common-stage derived tensor $L\operatorname{pr}_1^*K\otimes^L\mathcal K^{\mathrm{adic}}_{\Psi,b}$ [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. The general completed-realization construction is also defined for an arbitrary étale $\mathcal O_E$-module sheaf, without claiming constructibility for that arbitrary input.

proof.text: Every additive-character value has p-th power one. The roots-of-unity containment puts it in the fixed coefficient extension. Transport through the small-model equivalence; its absolute value has p-th power one and is nonnegative, so equals one. The DVR criterion makes the value integral. The injective fixed coefficient embedding gives the character laws and uniqueness.

The spectral norm of p in the finite ell-adic extension is its ell-adic norm, which is one since p and ell are distinct primes. The DVR unit criterion gives a unit in O_E, and the ULift ring equivalence transports it to the coefficient universe.

Pull back the universal Artin-Schreier etale surjection along the function b. Functoriality of etale inverse image, the pullback square, the existing artinSchreierSheafUpperStarIso and the constant-sheaf inverse-image comparison give an explicit regular-module trivialization on every member of this cover.

Apply the two general etale-line results to this particular integral sheaf and cover. The first supplies completeness; the second supplies finite constructible reductions with the single bound [0,0]. Assemble these with the witnesses 0,0 and reflexivity of <= into sfIntegralConstructible. The remaining constructions are the original ordinary scalar realization, common-stage kernel and derived tensor integrand.
